QUOTE: The pollers read `*cancel` and the observer writes `cancel_int = 1` (`response_generator.cpp:416`) with no atomic. ... The fix is to make the flag `std::atomic<int>`

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer treats the plain int cancel flag as a data race bug and doesn't say the observer thread exists to bridge an atomic into a plain int because the C ABI can't carry an atomic.
